name: Human-Robot Co-Manipulation Performance Metrics
description: Presents performance and physical human–robot interaction assessment metrics intended to benchmark co-manipulation task performance and interaction quality.
evaluation_method: human_eval (paired with task_success_rate and physical metrics such as force/effort and trajectory error)
reputation: Well-regarded within the human-robot interaction community as a concise set of co-manipulation metrics, though not a broadly standardized public benchmark.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark requiring human subjects and specialized hardware; results can vary with experimental setup and participant pool, limiting direct comparability.
